import html # Example template – adjust as needed for your web framework. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{biography}

{status}
""" def display_user_profile(fullname: str, biography: str, current_status: str) -> str: """ Render a user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- fullname : str The user's full name as entered. biography : str A user‑written bio that may contain multiple sentences. current_status : str A brief status message. Returns ------- str A sanitized, formatted HTML snippet ready for injection into a page. """ # Sanitize all user input to prevent XSS or other injection attacks. safe_name = html.escape(fullname, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(current_status, quote=True) # Construct the final profile string using the template. return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, biography=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
